name: nolgia
description: Generate images, video, and audio on NOLGIA, direct multi-shot video, and produce vertical UGC ads, all through the nolgia CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images, video, and audio with NOLGIA
interface.longDescription: NOLGIA skills turn Codex into a media production agent. Generate images, video with native audio, voiceovers, music, and sound effects from the live NOLGIA model catalog; outpaint a still to a new aspect ratio; direct multi-shot sequences; produce vertical UGC ads with a lip-synced talking head; and assemble finished clips into one rendered video. Everything runs through the nolgia CLI, which handles auth, uploads, async jobs, and credits.
defaultPrompt: Generate a 10 second cinematic clip of a coastline at dawn with NOLGIA
Extend this 16:9 photo to 9:16 for a story
Make a 15 second vertical UGC ad for my app
Write a multi-shot prompt for a 20 second trailer
List my failed NOLGIA jobs from today
